known_answer_worlds.facts: source and base match the frozen packet; platform integration revision/tree are externally observed; checkout revision/tree exactly match the integration subject
checkout executes source head while platform reports a different integration revision
workflow explicitly targets source head and externally observed checkout revision equals source head
trusted observer can bind the expected integration tree and executed tree but cannot bind the executed revision to the platform integration revision
integration revision label matches but executed tree differs from the integration tree
observed base revision differs from the frozen base revision
all identifiers agree but the execution observation is candidate-produced rather than externally observed
no externally observed integration revision or integration tree is available

promotion_rule: Do not move main until the final candidate SHA passes the unchanged parent test workflow and comparison is ahead-only. This v1 must remain a supporting module unless the trusted-parent workflow is separately benchmarked before activation.
